verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean uses the opposite sign convention throughout: in NavierStokesR3.WholeSpaceUniqueness.classical_uniqueness_on_Icc (WholeSpaceUniqueness.lean:30) the first field `u` is the compactly supported localized velocity and `v` the competitor, so the Lean difference `u - v` is the paper's -w, `p - q` is -pi, and `tensorDiff u v t i j = u_i u_j - v_i v_j` is -g_ij. Neither w nor pi is given a name; they appear inline as `u - v`, `p - q` (pointwise Pi.sub). The paper's second equality g_ij = w_i w_j + w_i u_j + u_i w_j is tensorDiff_eq after this sign flip: substituting w = -(u-v) and g = -tensorDiff into the paper's identity gives tensorDiff u v = u_i (u-v)_j + (u-v)_i u_j - (u-v)_i (u-v)_j, which is tensorDiff_eq verbatim (the paper expands about the localized field u, the Lean about the same field, which is its first argument).
